Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €351.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
For your information:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We are prepared to accept the CU-NOTATION index clause and your requested 90-day payment terms.
By implementing this index clause to manage material volatility, we can offer a revised price of EUR 351.80 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We note your updated offer, but the minor adjustment does not bridge the gap to a sustainable agreement. Our price of €351.80 per unit already incorporates your requested Zahlungsziel 90 days net and the Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. 

We must maintain our current offer and ask you to reconsider your position. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your slight adjustment, but it remains far below a viable level for us. To demonstrate our willingness to reach an agreement, we have reduced our price slightly to EUR 351.56 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €351.56 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We expect a more substantial step from your side in the next round to bridge the remaining gap.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your updated offer, but the marginal adjustment of EUR 0.35 is insufficient to bridge the remaining gap. 

Consequently, we must maintain our current offer of EUR 351.56 per unit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer comprises a price of €351.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

We require a substantial step from your side to reach a viable agreement.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
